Lake Errock is Mission's hidden treasure, offering waterfront living and recreational paradise for buyers seeking year-round outdoor lifestyle. This tight-knit community attracts families and retirees with properties ranging from cozy lakeside cottages to modern homes, many featuring water access, docks, and stunning lake and mountain views. Residents love the swimming, fishing, and water sports literally at their doorstep during summer months, plus hiking and nature activities throughout the year.

The community maintains a genuine neighbourhood feel where people know their neighbours and children grow up together enjoying outdoor adventures. Despite the recreational setting, Mission's shopping, schools, and services are just minutes away via Highway 7. Properties here offer exceptional value compared to other lakefront communities in the Lower Mainland, with larger lots and established character. The area's natural beauty and active lifestyle appeal make it perfect for those prioritizing recreation and community.
